name: Clean Energy Transition Inc.
summary: Clean Energy Transition Inc., a mining company, focuses on producing and selling dimensional limestone for landscape applications in Canada. Its project includes the Aurora Nickel project covering an area of 905 hectares located in southeast of Timmins, Ontario; and Silicon Ridge project located in Quebec. The company was formerly known as Rogue Resources Inc. and changed its name to Clean Energy Transition Inc. in May 2024. Clean Energy Transition Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
